title: yield from, send and close
summary: Generators talk both ways: send() feeds values in, return hands a summary out through StopIteration.value, yield from delegates all of it, and close() runs the finally block. Build a string-safe flatten, a primed running average, a collector for return values and a stream that always cleans up.

resources.label: PEP 380: Syntax for Delegating to a Subgenerator
